function: Channel estimation: a convolutional DNN maps received pilots to the uplink cascaded BS-RIS-user channel; the later localization stage uses IFFT and quasi-Newton and is not learned (pp. 5-7).
system: TDD mmWave MISO: BS ULA with 16 antennas, passive reflecting RIS UPA 8x8 (64 elements), single-antenna users; 28 GHz, 10 MHz (pp. 4, 9).
method: Convolutional DNN (three conv sets, 32 channels, linear output) with batch normalization; supervised MSE loss; distributed Adam training across K users with local datasets (pp. 5-6).
data_channel: Publicly available DeepMIMO dataset (scenario not named): 20,000 samples per user, 90% training and 10% testing, SNR 10 dB (p. 9).
test_conditions: Default 10 dB training and test SNR on a 90/10 split; sweeps of training SNR, test SNR, RIS elements, pilots, NLoS paths, fading coefficient (Figs. 4-6, pp. 10-12).
baselines: Channel estimation: LS, MMSE, SGD-DNN, Adam-DNN (same network, other optimizers); localization: LS, ML, RSS-KNN, DCS-SOMP, INTAL, SBL (pp. 9, 12-13).
metrics: NMSE of channel estimation; loss curves; localization errors (m, rad) of delay, clock bias, AOD and position against Cramer-Rao bounds (pp. 9-13).
openness: No own code or data link; uses the public DeepMIMO dataset (p. 9).
q1_support: p. 9: "publicly available DeepMIMO dataset"; the DNN is trained and tested on 20,000 samples of this dataset with a 90%/10% split; the scenario is not named.
q2_support: p. 9: "Both datasets are subjected to an SNR of 10 dB"; training and test samples are a 90/10 split of the same data, and Figs. 4-6 sweep SNR, RIS elements, pilots, NLoS paths and fading coefficient without stating a model trained on other conditions or any adaptation.
q3_support: p. 9: "estimation methods, namely the SGD-DNN, Adam-DNN, and"; LS and MMSE are non-learned baselines, but SGD-DNN and Adam-DNN are the same network trained with other optimizers (variants of the proposed distributed Adam-DNN) and no earlier learned estimator is compared.
q4_support: p. 3: "reduces computational complexity by decomposing the"; qualitative claim for the localization stage; no complexity order, FLOPs, parameter count or runtime is reported for the DNN or for the localization method.
q5_support: p. 9: "publicly available DeepMIMO dataset"; trains and tests on a public channel dataset, although no link and no code release are given.
notes: Included as area 2: the learned part is channel estimation of the RIS cascaded channel, while localization (IFFT, quasi-Newton) is classical, so the excluded localization function does not apply. q1 and q5 rest on the one sentence naming DeepMIMO (p. 9); the scenario is not named, the system model describes Saleh-Valenzuela channels (p. 4) and Fig. 6 varies NLoS paths and fading coefficient; reviewer may confirm how DeepMIMO is used. q2 = 0: Section III-A focuses on LoS links (p. 4) and Figs. 5-6 sweep pilots, RIS elements, NLoS paths and fading, but the paper never says the DNN was trained under other conditions than tested.
